title: Tie an overhand knot using a jig
instruction: Finish the overhand knot in the blue cord, remove it from the pegs and let go. The knot will be tested with a gentle pull.
context: Overhand knots can finish cord ends on drawstrings and bag handles. This task isolates knot completion from a prepared untied loop.
setup: One blue round cord, 118 cm nominal centreline length (118.8 cm including end caps), 8 mm diameter and 46.1 g, approximating braided polyester. Its first and last 1 cm links are yellow and red. A fixed grey clamp holds the yellow end. The cord starts with one untied crossing on three rounded 16 mm steel-like pegs and rigid metal posts fixed to the 110×130×6 cm wooden YAM tabletop. Nothing attaches the cord to the pegs or grippers. The README gives the exact layout and fixture dimensions.
scoring: 0.5: an intact single overhand knot is present at the end of the robot actions, with the entire cord at least 3 cm from every robot part and 1 cm from every peg and support. 1.0: that knot remains tied and clear throughout a pull on the red end away from the clamped yellow end: a 2-second linear ramp to 0.981 N, then a 5-second hold within ±5%. A failed or unfinished load test retains established 0.5 credit; damaged cord or invalid simulation evidence scores 0. All other outcomes score 0.
run_limit: 2,400 robot control steps (120 seconds at 20 Hz). A separate 7-second evaluator load test follows a qualifying released knot.
reset_notes: Untie the cord and restore the shown single-crossed loop on the three pegs. Keep the yellow end clamped. All parts are reusable.
fidelity: 118 rigid capsules approximate an inextensible cord; links collide and grasps use contact. A fixed joint models the clamp. The red end is externally loaded; an equal opposite force on the yellow end is reacted by its clamp. Fibres, stretch and wear are not modelled. Friction and bending are uncalibrated. A brief native velocity spike occurred during demo handover; sampled geometry passed, but 20 Hz checks cannot establish continuous physical fidelity.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 after 2,400 actions; scripted demo: 1.0 after 1,866 actions plus the 7-second load test. Independently rescored.
